# Savvy Flow

A Claude Code orchestration flow you start yourself with /savvy-flow <task>: an orchestrator plans the work, writes the spec (you approve it before anything is built), owns the design and delegates to five pinned worker agents, reviews their output adversarially, and commits accepted work, never pushing without being asked. The five worker agents ship and install with it; without them the workflow stops, by design.
